verdict: TRAP-VERIFY KILL — SCREEN-MISCLASSIFIED on a one-time-gain artifact. ROE 7.7% is not a quality signal: Q2-26 profit $235M sits on $19M of OPERATING profit, and H1 attributable $389M on $41M operating — the gap is a $307M Superbank consolidation remeasurement gain (the company's own words: 'one-time in nature') plus $66M of deferred-tax-asset recognition (DTA $85M->$178M, ties out). Strip both and H1 attributable is ~$16M: CORRECTED ROE ~0.5-2%, not 7.7%. 'Adjusted FCF $450M TTM' is the same disease — IFRS operating cash flow was NEGATIVE $3M in H1; the figure exists only by adding back $369M of loan-receivable growth, which is not distributable cash. On real lines: ~13.6x guided adj-EBITDA and ~120x annualized operating profit. Live tail: gross loan book +197% YoY to $2.3B unseasoned, impairments $72M in Q2 = 3.8x the group's entire operating profit.
lane: quality_drawdown (first courts ever run from this lane)
reopen_gates: NONE. Re-admit only on a net-income-vs-operating-income reconciliation the screen currently cannot perform.
